text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin has shown a spectacular performance over these three years. Having consistently delivered results, she is now—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Yukino-san!
So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya!?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
It's dazzling just looking at it.
Haa... so lovely...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I was bewildered by the passionate gazes
from my juniors.
choice_data_list: You're truly the school's star sweetheart now.
You really are the academy's idol, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whad'ya mean!?
Quit soundin' like my ol' man,
would ya!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... it feels different from before.
The way people are payin' attention to me, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So... so cute.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I have had people say
things like that to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S-So cool... and dreamy.
I wonder why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet,
several Umamusume preparing for their upcoming
debuts began to gather.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Yukino, I have a favor to ask...
Could you tell us how you managed to pull off such an amazing performance?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“—Umamusume who have claimed the Triple Tiara
don't come around very often, after all!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She's seriously amazing!
Among the pre-debut group,
she's the hottest Umamusume right now!
choice_data_list: (I see, so that's why it's getting so much attention.)
(I see, that's why it's drawing so much attention.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, a passionate Umamusume...!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Somehow, that makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once I debut,
I plan to aim for the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I want to work hard just like Yukino-chan!
Could you tell me anything about it
so I can use it as reference?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I dunno if I can talk real well
or anything, but...
If I'll do, then sure...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —So, wh-why in such a huge place...?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san~!
Looking forward to working with you today~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The crowd is growing too...!
What on earth is going on!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I hear they're all girls
aiming for the Triple Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Being a Triple Tiara Umamusume
is what so many girls dream of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Just putting it on myself isn't the end of it.
Shining bright comes with its own responsibility, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, everyone!
Is it okay if I decide what to talk about today myself?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I have to speak in my own words.
So I don't bring shame to the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks! I always intended for you
to speak freely, anyway.
Nice to have you with us, Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "—An' so, me and Trainer worked real hard on some crazy trainin'."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, when I won the Shuka Sho, honestly that was the last thing on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: In the end, I never really got to celebrate your Triple Tiara properly, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Being able to speak with my head held high in front of
everyone like this is the best celebration I could ask for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, Yukino Bijin's expression
looks a little more grown-up than before.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“—The Triple Tiara alone is an incredible feat,
and yet she went on to win
the Victoria Mile and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup too!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She's seriously amaziiing~!
Among the pre-debut group, she's a total legend!
choice_data_list: (I see, so that's why it's getting so much attention.)
(I see, that's why it's drawing so much attention.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: L-Legendary?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that's straight-up legendary!
I wanna go on a massive winning spree like that too~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—And then, I'll carve out my very own legend!
The Vodka of Legend Road...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa, that's so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, told ya, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How to win over and over again—
you should know the way, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tell me. How did you become
such a cool Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's...—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —In short, it's all about guts, gansu!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Guts?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's the only thing about myself that I can truly say with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Umm... what about devising a strategy,
or honing a unique weapon of your own...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've managed to push through everything with pure guts!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: G-Guts...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that an essential part of running all the way?
What are you so hesitant about?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought something, like... way more stylish
and super cool was gonna show up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No, sir, I'm just a plain ol'
mud-splattered Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, on rainy days, snowy days, and windy days alike,
I have simply kept running, and nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"And as for what happened next,
yours truly is living proof!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-So badass...!
Crazy slick...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! My bad, I was wrong!
Guts and grit are as cool as it gets...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Drill it into me too, please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Please take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...So simple-minded.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: “Still, we can't fall behind either...! Everyone, stay close behind those two!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin dashing vigorously before everyone.
Her gallant figure seemed to embody
one form of a "City Girl."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—You put up incredible results
on the Tiara route, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She's so badass, isn't she?!
Running in so many GⅠ races and all!
choice_data_list: (I see, so that's why it's getting so much attention.)
(I see, that's why it's drawing so much attention.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, so you were watching!
Thank ya kindly!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And so, Yukino-chan, we'd love it if you could share your race experiences with us!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Jumping in headfirst with zero prep...
I mean, that sounds super badass, but...
Scarlet is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean, why wouldn't I when there's someone with firsthand experience right beside me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Asking lots of questions now
is definitely gonna help you out in the future!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What do you think, could you do this for me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If you're okay with me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you,
Yukino-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aya?
Curren-san, you too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Curren also likes
how "Tiara" sounds♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I bought some snacks too, so why don't we chat while we munch on them?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's diamant cookies, financiers...
Pick whatever you like! ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah, they're all super
fancy sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, mind if I join you?
I bought some juice~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"What about chips?
I'll go check the school store!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A-At this rate... I won't be able to talk about anything serious, will I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
Hey, let's go buy something salty too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
it looks like it's gonna be pretty lively!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I watched over Yukino Bijin as she happily chatted away, surrounded by her friends.
